metadata.description: Claude Code skills and plugins for document and compliance workflows.

plugins.name: assign-documents
plugins.description: Categorize documents and assign them to items in a source of Excel files, then produce a consolidated Excel report.

plugins.name: generate-workbook
plugins.description: Work in progress. Build a Worldmaker app's migration workbook — out of raw customer source files when the customer did not supply one, or to attach a folder of documents onto items that already exist in the app.

plugins.name: categorise-documents
plugins.description: Give every file in a list its document type, read in parallel batches with every document accounted for.

plugins.name: verify-document-skills-requirements
plugins.description: Install Anthropic's official document skills if absent, then probe every tool they require on this system and report what is missing.

plugins.name: data-site
plugins.description: Display a dataset as a browsable site — icon rail, nav panel, list tables and item detail pages — delivered as one self-contained HTML file.
